name: Meeting Ink
description: Meeting Ink brings your meetings into Claude. Search across past conversations, pull full transcripts, AI summaries, and multilingual translations, and reference your team's custom terminology—all without leaving the chat. Turn what was said in any meeting into follow-up emails, trip reports, CRM notes, or decision logs in seconds, and combine it with everything else you're working on. Built for teams running lots of meetings who want every conversation instantly searchable, summarizable, and ready to reuse inside their AI workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Meeting Ink to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Meeting Ink to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ink-mcp.dwave.cc/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Meeting Ink MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Meeting Ink lists 20 MCP tools, including get_latest_transcript, get_meeting, get_meeting_summary, get_quota, get_workspace_latest_transcript, get_workspace_meeting, get_workspace_meeting_summary, list_meetings, list_shared_meetings, list_summaries, list_terminology, and list_transcripts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Meeting Ink?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Meeting Ink in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Meeting Ink MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Meeting Ink requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Meeting Ink is developed by DeepWave Co., Ltd.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
